run.name: Element Solutions Inc
run.title: CP-OS host session (ESI)
run.summary: Element Solutions has moderate reported leverage of 3.09x, strong earnings growth, cash interest cover of 7.85x and adequate liquidity of USD 702.9 million. Debt-funded acquisitions raised leverage, and cash conversion is weaker than earnings. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context.

revenue.basis: Net sales, as the CP-1 table prints it.

ebitda.basis: EBITDA, issuer-defined, as the CP-1 table prints it.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Debt 2,082.1, cash 224.9; LTM Adjusted EBITDA 673.1; same limitation; on the release's debt table net debt 1,869.8 gives 2.78x; not a covenant ratio

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. LTM Adjusted EBITDA 673.1 over LTM interest paid 85.7; interest paid is a cash measure and differs from accrual interest expense, net, of 81.2 LTM; C5

cash.basis: Cash. Revolver with 15.0 drawn, net of letters of credit of 7.0 (Q3-26 p18); of the cash, 176 is held by foreign subsidiaries; total availability across all lines is 506

cashflow.basis: Net cash flows from operating activities, as the CP-1 table prints it.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: Covenant definitions, the terminated merger's terms and pro forma EBITDA for the acquisitions are not supplied.
CP-1 main limitation: Last-twelve-months EBITDA includes the acquired businesses only from their 2026 closing dates, and covenant definitions are not supplied.
